title: Peacemaker Helmets
description: Experience Peacemaker's various helmets in Minecraft with this mod!
body:
# **Peacemaker Helmets**

Based from the DC character and HBO series "Peacemaker", this mod aims to bring the various helmets showcased from the show to minecraft! Be it from the original helmet from TSS, to the destructive power of the Sonic Boom helmet, 

![Peacemaker Helmets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b8e7d1dd9d2fef559cd28aa261eddbfaf5e7955b.png)

## 🦅 _Helmet Abilities_:

All helmets are activated by a single, configurable keybind (default: V)

- X-Ray Helmet: This helmet highlights every mob and player within a 24-block radius,
- Sonic Boom Helmet: Explode the area around you. It has 3 charges that recharges one charge every 3 mins
- Torpedo Helmet: Launch yourself at high speed like a torpedo
- Underwater Helmet: Move freely and breathe underwater
- Anti-Gravity Helmet: Look up and go up. Does not come with falling immunity
- Scabies Helmet: Will affect and damage any living entity in the area except its user.

## ⚙️ _Helmet Features_:

- Headshot protection: All Peacemaker helmets provide significant headshot damage reduction, any hits from projectiles or melee attacks aimed at the player head is reduced.
- Explore to Find: Peacemaker's Helmets are scattered across the world for you to find. Be it from abandoned mineshafts, bastions, ocean ruins, woodlands mansions and more!

### **What's Next?**
- Possible addition of other helmets from the comics or suggestions from the comments. 
- A Quantum Unfolding Chamber portal as a pocket dimension and storage for all the helmets


This mod uses and requires Geckolib 4.8.2 or higher
[https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/RVIo5f6E](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib/version/RVIo5f6E)
